result:
Every check on the newly-failing list is now fixed or retargeted. I reran the 19 that were still red at the start of this run with `runchk.sh`, and all 19 pass. The results are in `reds4.out`.

None of the failures was a real game break. All were option (b): the check pinned an old layout or wording that a later ship changed on purpose. So no game ship was needed, only edits to `tools/mkfixture.ps1`, committed in `752cf020`, `823d06df`, `7dd7ce2c` and `e4926979`.

- **Never-all-caps rule:** most of the reds. The drawn text is now sentence case, so the checks compare against that and the probe strings are written that way.
- **Credits readout:** the style guide shrank it from 32px to 24px, so the check now asks for 24px or more and 36px tall.
- **Quantity prompt:** its way out is Cancel and Esc, not a Close button, so the modal-close check accepts that.
- **Mode row height:** the minimum went from 50px to 48px.
- **Legend:** the check ignores same-spelled words drawn alone in the lower panels, so only the two-column legend counts.

Two exceptions: 18.73 is a SKIP because there are no title step cards in this build, and 18.11 was already retargeted by an earlier ship.

I didn't run the full gate, so whether the stable promotion script now accepts a newer version is untested. Per-check notes are in `notes/00-fix-new-reds.md`.

TASK DONE
